== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Vader's Bounty (V) (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 2 slip 50E), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published full card image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Vader's Bounty (V)]] (original).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list writes icons out; icons are drawn as on the printed slip. The Master List prints the same text; the Advanced Rulebook 2.0 has it without the comma after "Vader".
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Slave I is destiny +2 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. During battle: while non-[Reflections III] Boba Fett with Vader, neither may be excluded or lost until the damage segment, and may place this Effect in Lost Pile to make Boba Fett's total weapon destiny +3.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1002_L6727</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>5_125</code>, title, lore, icons, set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
